entities.name: Munetsugu Takeno
entities.description: General of the Eiganjo samurai forces of daimyo Takeshi Konda, obsessed with justice.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Daimyo of Eiganjo whom Takeno served.

entities.name: Shiro
entities.description: Young soldier who saved Takeno and died.

entities.name: Captain Matsuda
entities.description: Captain reprimanded and arrested by Takeno.

events.summary: At age 34 Takeno is given command of Konda's forces.
events.quote: Takeno was given command of Daimyo Konda's forces

events.summary: Takeno leads forces down Eiganjo Hill against the kami in the early days of the Kami War.
events.quote: Takeno would lead his forces down Eiganjo Hill every third morning

events.summary: Takeno chastises the courtier Atsumori Fushimi for delaying news from Kodaira and interrogates Shiro.
events.quote: He swiftly chastised the courtier, Atsumori Fushimi

events.summary: Takeno leads a surprise attack on the nezumi; Shiro saves him and dies.
events.quote: Takeno was briefly incapacitated but was saved by Shiro

events.summary: Takeno has Captain Matsuda arrested for letting villagers into the outpost.
When O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo, Takeno shields Konda from a rock and is impaled.
events.quote: Takeno leaped in the way of a huge flying sliver of rock

events.summary: Takeno is recreated as a spirit, and ceases to exist when O-Kagachi is destroyed by the Sisters of Flesh and Spirit.
events.quote: ceased to exist when O-Kagachi was destroyed

relations.quote: he served Konda faithfully and without question
Takeno refused to abandon his lord
